name: electron-next-host
displayName: Electron host for a Next.js app
description: Electron desktop shell that starts and hosts a sibling Next.js app (and optionally its Docker Compose services) instead of bundling a Vite renderer. Keeps the electron pack security defaults: sandbox, context isolation, single instance, validated IPC.

included: Electron main process that hosts a sibling Next.js app
host.config.json: web app path, port, dist dir, optional Docker Compose and API origin
Security best practices (sandbox, context isolation, single instance, IPC validation)
excluded: Packaged builds (V1 runs from a terminal with pnpm dev; the app starts the sibling web app's dev server)
